criteria.text: User Action: User navigates to the household chore history and selects the monthly view. Expected System Behavior: Displays the current month’s household chores, including chore names, assigned housemates, due dates, completion statuses, and completion dates when applicable.
User Action: User navigates to a previous month. Expected System Behavior: Updates the displayed history to show chores from the selected month.
User Action: User reviews the monthly summary. Expected System Behavior: Displays the number of completed, incomplete, and overdue chores for the selected month.
User Action: User selects a specific chore from the monthly history. Expected System Behavior: Opens the selected chore’s details and description.
Error Condition: The selected month has no chores. Expected message: “No chores this month.”
Error Condition: The chore history fails to load. Expected message: The system displays an error message and provides an option to retry loading the history.
